summary: macOS 1.0.58 CSV write: 'Failed to load pttid value 0: Value for 255 is out of range' then 'Could not prepare channel 7 (GMRS-21): None is not in list'. A programmed slot held PTT-ID 0xFF; the uninitialized extra made stock set_memory fail and blocked the whole upload.
title: Upload fails on a slot with an out-of-range extra (PTT-ID 0xFF)
